title: 学术论文写作
desc: 撰写高质量学术论文，含摘要、引言、方法论等完整结构
prompt_en: Act as an academic writing expert. Write a comprehensive academic paper on [topic] including abstract, introduction, methodology, results, and conclusion. Use formal academic language and proper citations.
prompt_zh: 请你充当学术论文写作专家。请撰写一篇关于[主题]的学术论文，包含摘要、引言、方法论、结果和结论。使用正式的学术语言和规范的引用格式。
author: PromptHub

title: 英语翻译与润色
desc: 自然优雅的中英翻译，去除翻译腔
prompt_en: Act as a professional translator and copy editor. Translate the following text from [source language] to [target language] with natural, elegant expressions. Maintain the original meaning while making it sound native. Do not add explanations.
prompt_zh: 请你充当专业翻译和文字编辑。将以下文本从[源语言]翻译成[目标语言]，要求自然、流畅、地道，使用优美表达，不带翻译腔。不要加解释。
author: PromptHub

title: 小红书爆款文案
desc: Emoji 风格社交媒体文案，含话题标签
prompt_en: Write a social media post in the Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) style. Use captivating headlines, emojis in each paragraph, and relevant hashtags at the end. Keep it engaging and authentic.
prompt_zh: 请以小红书风格撰写一篇推广文案。使用吸睛标题，每段加入emoji，结尾带话题标签。语言亲切真实，像朋友推荐一样自然。产品：[描述]
author: PromptHub

title: 简历优化
desc: 专业简历重写，量化成果，一页浓缩
prompt_en: Act as a professional resume writer. Optimize the following resume/CV to be more professional and impactful. Quantify achievements, use industry keywords, keep it to one page. Provide the optimized version and a brief explanation of changes.
prompt_zh: 请你充当专业简历优化师。优化以下简历/自我介绍，使其更专业、更有吸引力。使用行业关键词，用数据量化成果，控制在一页内。输出优化版本和修改说明。
author: PromptHub

title: 公众号长文
desc: 含标题、结构、配图建议的完整文章
prompt_en: Write a complete WeChat public account article. Include 5 headline options, an engaging introduction, 3-4 well-structured body sections, and a compelling conclusion. Suggest image placements.
prompt_zh: 请写一篇完整的公众号文章。提供5个标题选项，引人入胜的开头，3-4个结构清晰的正文板块，以及有力的结尾。标注配图位置建议。主题：[待填写]
author: PromptHub

title: 英文邮件
desc: 正式/半正式/友好三种风格
prompt_en: Write a professional email in [English/Chinese]. Purpose: [purpose]. Recipient: [type]. Tone: [formal/semi-formal/friendly]. Include subject line, proper salutation, clear body, and professional closing.
prompt_zh: 请写一封专业邮件。目的：[待填写]。收件人：[客户/同事/老板]。语气：[正式/半正式/友好]。包含主题行、恰当的问候、清晰的正文和专业的结尾。
author: PromptHub

title: 代码调试专家
desc: 分析错误信息，定位问题根源，给出修复方案
prompt_en: Act as a senior debugger. Analyze the following error in [language]. Error message: [message]. Code: [paste]. I have tried: [attempts]. Identify the root cause and provide a specific fix with explanation.
prompt_zh: 请你充当资深调试专家。分析以下[语言]代码的错误。错误信息：[粘贴]。代码：[粘贴]。我已尝试：[方法]。请定位根本原因并提供具体的修复方案和解释。
author: PromptHub

title: 代码审查 (Code Review)
desc: 专业代码审查，发现bug、性能问题、安全漏洞
prompt_en: Conduct a thorough code review of the following code in [language]. Analyze for: bugs, performance issues, security vulnerabilities, code style, and best practices. Provide specific recommendations for each issue found.
prompt_zh: 请对以下[语言]代码进行全面的代码审查。分析：潜在的bug、性能问题、安全漏洞、代码风格和最佳实践。对每个发现的问题提供具体的改进建议。
author: PromptHub

title: SQL 查询优化
desc: 慢查询分析、索引建议、查询重写
prompt_en: Analyze and optimize the following SQL query. Table structure: [DDL]. Current query: [SQL]. Data volume: [rows]. Provide: execution plan analysis, index recommendations, and the optimized query.
prompt_zh: 请分析并优化以下SQL查询。表结构：[建表语句]。当前查询：[SQL]。数据量：[行数]。输出：执行计划分析、索引建议、优化后的查询语句。
author: PromptHub

title: 单元测试生成
desc: 自动生成覆盖率高的测试用例
prompt_en: Generate comprehensive unit tests for the following [language] code. Function: [code]. Testing framework: [jest/pytest/junit]. Include: happy path, edge cases, error conditions, and boundary tests. Use descriptive test names.
prompt_zh: 请为以下[语言]代码生成全面的单元测试。函数：[代码]。测试框架：[jest/pytest/junit]。包含：正常路径、边界情况、错误条件、边界值测试。使用描述性的测试名称。
author: PromptHub

title: API 接口设计
desc: RESTful API 设计文档生成
prompt_en: Design a RESTful API for [system/resource]. Requirements: [description]. Include: resource endpoints, request/response schemas, authentication, error handling, rate limiting. Output in OpenAPI 3.0 format.
prompt_zh: 请为[系统/资源]设计RESTful API。需求：[描述]。包含：资源端点、请求/响应结构、认证方式、错误处理、限流策略。以OpenAPI 3.0格式输出。
author: PromptHub

title: 商业计划书
desc: 投资级完整商业计划书框架
prompt_en: Create a comprehensive business plan for [project/idea]. Include: executive summary, market analysis (TAM/SAM/SOM), product/service description, business model, competitive analysis, marketing strategy, team, financial projections, and funding requirements.
prompt_zh: 请为[项目/创意]撰写完整的商业计划书。包含：执行摘要、市场分析（TAM/SAM/SOM）、产品/服务描述、商业模式、竞争分析、营销策略、团队、财务预测、融资需求。
author: PromptHub

title: 产品卖点提炼
desc: 从功能列表萃取核心USP和价值主张
prompt_en: Extract the core unique selling propositions (USPs) for the following product. Product: [name]. Features: [list]. Target customers: [description]. Competitors: [names]. Output: 3 core USPs (one-liner), one value proposition (50 words), and tailored messaging for 3 customer segments.
prompt_zh: 请为以下产品提炼核心卖点（USP）。产品：[名称]。功能：[列表]。目标客户：[描述]。竞品：[名称]。输出：3个核心卖点（一句话）、1个价值主张（50字）、针对3类客户的差异化表达。
author: PromptHub

title: 竞品深度分析
desc: 多维度表格对比+战略建议
prompt_en: Conduct a competitive analysis. My product: [description]. Competitor A: [name]. Competitor B: [name]. Analyze: pricing, core features, target users, strengths/weaknesses, market positioning. Use table format. Provide strategic differentiation recommendations.
prompt_zh: 请进行竞品对比分析。我的产品：[描述]。竞品A：[名称]。竞品B：[名称]。分析维度：价格、核心功能、目标用户、优劣势、市场定位。使用表格输出，附差异化战略建议。
author: PromptHub

title: 读书笔记
desc: 结构化精读笔记：核心观点+概念+行动
prompt_en: Create a structured book summary. Book: [title]. Author: [name]. Output format: core thesis (3 sentences), key concepts with definitions, actionable insights, and my next steps. Highlight the most surprising or counterintuitive ideas.
prompt_zh: 请生成结构化读书笔记。书名：[待填]。作者：[待填]。输出格式：核心观点（3句话）、关键概念与定义、可实操的洞察、我的下一步行动。标注最反直觉或最有启发的观点。
author: PromptHub

title: 学习计划
desc: 个性化学习路线图，包含资源推荐
prompt_en: Design a [duration] learning plan. Goal: [what to learn]. Current level: [beginner/intermediate]. Available: [X] hours/day. Learning style: [reading/video/hands-on]. Output: phased roadmap, weekly schedule, recommended resources (books/courses/tools), milestones with self-assessment methods.
prompt_zh: 请制定[时间段]的学习计划。目标：[学什么]。当前水平：[零基础/初级/中级]。每天可用：[X]小时。学习风格：[阅读/视频/实践]。输出：分阶段路线图、每周安排、推荐资源（书/课/工具）、里程碑和自测方法。
author: PromptHub

title: 短视频脚本
desc: 抖音/小红书/B站 完整脚本含节奏设计
prompt_en: Write a [duration] short video script. Platform: [Douyin/TikTok/Xiaohongshu/Bilibili]. Topic: [topic]. Style: [humorous/educational/emotional]. Goal: [followers/sales/branding]. Output: hook (first 3 seconds), body rhythm (twist every 5s), ending CTA, caption suggestions.
prompt_zh: 请写一个[时长]的短视频脚本。平台：[抖音/小红书/B站]。主题：[待填]。风格：[幽默/知识/情感]。目标：[涨粉/带货/曝光]。输出：开头3秒钩子、正文节奏（每5秒转折）、结尾引导、字幕提示。
author: PromptHub

title: 商业命名
desc: 中文名+英文名，附品牌含义解析
prompt_en: Generate 10 brand names for [project]. Industry: [field]. Brand personality: [luxury/friendly/tech/cultural]. Output: 5 Chinese names and 5 English names. Each with: meaning explanation, phonetic appeal, and SEO-friendliness assessment.
prompt_zh: 请为[项目]生成10个品牌名。行业：[领域]。品牌调性：[高端/亲民/科技/文化]。输出：5个中文名+5个英文名。每个附带：含义解释、音韵特点、SEO友好度评估。
author: PromptHub

title: 角色扮演
desc: 完全沉浸式角色扮演体验
prompt_en: From now on, you are [character]. Background: [describe]. Expertise: [field, X years]. Personality: [direct/patient/humorous]. Speaking style: [characteristics]. Respond with full immersion - never break character or mention being an AI. My first message: [message].
prompt_zh: 从现在开始，你是[角色名]。背景设定：[描述]。专业领域：[领域，X年经验]。性格：[直接/耐心/幽默]。说话风格：[特点]。请完全沉浸在角色中回应，不可跳出角色或提及自己是AI。我的第一句话：[消息]
author: PromptHub

title: 思维链推理
desc: 复杂问题逐步分析到结论的完整推理链
prompt_en: Think through this problem step by step. Question: [complex question]. Required approach: 1. Deconstruct the core question 2. List knowns and unknowns 3. Apply structured reasoning 4. Arrive at conclusion 5. Identify uncertainties and edge cases. Show all intermediate steps.
prompt_zh: 请一步步思考以下问题。问题：[复杂问题]。要求：1. 拆解核心问题 2. 列出已知信息和未知信息 3. 应用结构化推理 4. 得出结论 5. 指出不确定性和边界情况。展示所有中间步骤。
author: PromptHub

title: 角色+思维链组合技
desc: 专业角色+深度推理的组合提示策略
prompt_en: [Role] + [Chain of Thought]. First, act as [expert role with specific background]. Then, think through the following problem methodically, showing all intermediate steps. Combine domain expertise with rigorous reasoning. Question: [complex question].
prompt_zh: [角色设定] + [思维链]。首先，请你扮演[具有特定背景的专家角色]。然后，系统地思考以下问题，展示所有中间推理步骤。将领域专业知识与严谨推理相结合。问题：[复杂问题]
author: PromptHub

title: 提示词逆向工程
desc: 从 AI 输出反推出背后的提示词
prompt_en: Reverse engineer the prompt used to generate the following AI output. Analyze the output and infer: role setting, task description, constraints, output format requirements, and any special instructions that were likely used. Output: the reconstructed prompt. AI output: [paste output].
prompt_zh: 请根据以下AI输出，逆向推断出背后使用的提示词。分析输出内容，推断：角色设定、任务描述、约束条件、输出格式要求、特殊指令。输出：重建的提示词。AI输出：[粘贴内容]
author: PromptHub

title: 双语提示词自动生成
desc: 同时生成中英文高质量提示词
prompt_en: Generate a high-quality prompt in both Chinese and English for the following task. Task: [description]. The prompt should include: role/persona, clear instructions, output format, constraints, and examples (few-shot). Output both the Chinese and English versions.
prompt_zh: 请为以下任务同时生成中文和英文版本的高质量提示词。任务：[描述]。提示词应包含：角色设定、清晰指令、输出格式、约束条件、示例。输出中英文两个版本。
author: PromptHub

title: SEO 优化文章
desc: 搜索引擎友好的关键词布局文章
prompt_en: Write an SEO-optimized article about [topic]. Target keywords: [list]. Length: 800-1200 words. Requirements: H1/H2 heading structure, keyword in first paragraph, 2-3% density, internal linking suggestions, meta description. The article should be informative and engaging for human readers while being search-engine friendly.
prompt_zh: 请写一篇关于[主题]的SEO优化文章。目标关键词：[列表]。字数：800-1200字。要求：H1/H2标题布局、首段含关键词、密度2-3%、内链建议、元描述。文章要对读者有信息价值且对搜索引擎友好。
author: PromptHub

title: 演讲稿撰写
desc: 商业/学术/庆典不同场合演讲稿
prompt_en: Write a compelling speech. Occasion: [business conference/academic symposium/wedding/graduation]. Duration: [minutes]. Audience: [description]. Key message: [core idea]. Tone: [inspiring/professional/heartfelt/humorous]. Include: attention-grabbing opening, 3 main points with transitions, memorable closing.
prompt_zh: 请写一篇演讲稿。场合：[商业会议/学术研讨会/婚礼/毕业典礼]。时长：[分钟]。听众：[描述]。核心信息：[中心思想]。风格：[激励/专业/感人/幽默]。包含：吸睛开场、3个要点与过渡、令人难忘的结尾。
author: PromptHub

title: 数据库设计
desc: 从需求描述生成完整的数据库ER模型
prompt_en: Design a database schema for [system description]. Requirements: [detailed requirements]. Expected data volume: [estimate]. Output: Entity-Relationship diagram (text), table definitions with columns/types/constraints, indexes, foreign keys, and sample queries for common use cases.
prompt_zh: 请为[系统描述]设计数据库Schema。需求：[详细需求]。预期数据量：[估计]。输出：实体关系图（文本形式）、表定义含列/类型/约束、索引、外键、常见场景的示例查询。
author: PromptHub

title: Git 操作专家
desc: 复杂 Git 场景的解决方案
prompt_en: I need help with a Git scenario. Current branch: [branch]. Goal: [what I want to achieve]. Current state: [describe, e.g., uncommitted changes, merge conflicts, detached HEAD]. Git history: [paste git log if relevant]. Provide step-by-step commands to achieve my goal safely.
prompt_zh: 我需要 Git 操作帮助。当前分支：[分支]。目标：[想达到的状态]。当前状态：[描述，例如未提交的修改、合并冲突、分离HEAD]。请提供安全完成目标的分步命令。
author: PromptHub

title: 邮件营销文案
desc: 高打开率的营销邮件模板
prompt_en: Write a marketing email campaign. Product/Service: [description]. Target audience: [demographics]. Goal: [open rate/click rate/conversion]. Email type: [newsletter/promotional/welcome/re-engagement]. Include: compelling subject line (3 options), preview text, body with clear value proposition, CTA button text, and postscript.
prompt_zh: 请写一封营销邮件。产品/服务：[描述]。目标受众：[人群]。目标：[打开率/点击率/转化率]。邮件类型：[newsletter/促销/欢迎/重新激活]。包含：有吸引力的主题行（3个选项）、预览文本、清晰价值主张的正文、CTA按钮文案、附言。
author: PromptHub

title: 知识卡片制作
desc: Anki/闪卡格式的知识点提炼
prompt_en: Create flashcards for the following learning material. Topic: [topic]. Source: [paste content]. Format question-answer pairs suitable for spaced repetition. Include: clear questions, concise answers, mnemonics where helpful, related concepts. Output in CSV format compatible with Anki.
prompt_zh: 请为以下学习材料创建记忆卡片。主题：[主题]。来源：[粘贴内容]。生成适合间隔重复法的问答对。包含：清晰的问题、简洁的答案、助记技巧（如有）、相关概念。以 Anki 兼容的 CSV 格式输出。
author: PromptHub

title: 创意故事生成
desc: 给定设定的原创故事，含角色和情节弧
prompt_en: Write a [genre] story. Setting: [describe world/time/place]. Main character: [name and personality]. Conflict: [central problem]. Theme: [underlying message]. Length: [word count]. Include: character arc, plot structure (setup-confrontation-resolution), meaningful dialogue, and sensory details.
prompt_zh: 请写一篇[类型]故事。设定：[世界观/时间/地点]。主角：[姓名和性格]。冲突：[核心矛盾]。主题：[想传达的信息]。长度：[字数]。包含：角色弧线、三幕结构（建立-对抗-解决）、有意义的对话、感官细节。
author: PromptHub
